subject: Onsite Airlock SOW Clarifications & Evidence Submission Plan
messages:
From: Stacey Mills <stacey.mills@clearwellhealth.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@clearwellhealth.com
Date: Fri, 05 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request for clarifications: Onsite airlocked SOW & evidence list

Rafael —

Thanks for the materials you shared in the RFI. As we prepare our procurement packet for the Clearwell Health security review board, we need a couple of clarifications and a short evidence package that addresses our on-prem / air-gapped requirements. Can you confirm the items below and provide the requested artifacts?

1) Network boundary diagram showing egress paths from the private deployment to Redwood support/control plane (if applicable).
2) An inventory table of artifacts that map to our evidence requirements (installation steps, operator roles, telemetry points). Prefer CSV or XLSX.
3) Confirmation of operator access model and KMS/HSM integration (customer-managed vs Redwood-managed).
4) A proposed timeline for a pilot in our DC (two-week snapshot + operator handoff).
5) Sample MOU language for isolated support windows and remote support (for legal).

Attachments requested: We attached our RFI template (Clearwell_RFI_Template.pdf) for your ease — please fill the inventory table into the template where possible.

We'd like to close this loop by end of business Friday (2028-05-12). Would you be able to send an evidence package and a proposed pilot schedule this week?

Appreciate it — happy to jump on a short call if helpful.

-Stacey
Stacey Mills
Senior IT Procurement, Clearwell Health

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 05 May 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request for clarifications: Onsite airlocked SOW & evidence list

Stacey —

Thanks for the clear list. We're on it. Summary / plan below:

- Network boundary diagram: attached (network_diagram.pdf). Diagram highlights two deployment modes we support for on-prem: (A) fully air-gapped with no outbound egress; (B) VPC with a controlled egress endpoint for telemetry/fallback. For your DC pilot we recommend mode (B) unless your security team requires absolute air-gap.

- Inventory / evidence table: attached as RFI_Attachment_Table_v3.xlsx. The spreadsheet maps Clearwell evidence items to Redwood artifacts (runbooks, SBOM, telemetry points, KMS details).

- Operator access & KMS: For pilot we propose customer-managed KMS (recommended) with Redwood support accounts restricted to a jump-host pattern. Mina will provide the exact key rotation cadence and operator RBAC entries in the second tab of the XLSX.

- Pilot timeline: propose:
  * Week 0 (prep): paperwork, network whitelists, key provisioning (3 business days)
  * Week 1 (deploy): on-site / remote install and basic validation (2 business days)
  * Week 2 (snapshot + handoff): runbook walkthrough, operator credentialing, telemetry verification (5 business days)

- MOU language: attached as a short stub in the XLSX and I'll push a DocuSign-ready MOU once legal has a look.

Attachments: RFI_Attachment_Table_v3.xlsx (inventory/evidence mapping), network_diagram.pdf (deployment boundary).

If you need the fully air-gapped (no egress) variant, we can provide an addendum with additional operator-only tooling and offline patch process — that'll add ~1 week to the ops validation in our estimate.

I'll follow up after Ben and Mina review the security wording. If you'd like to schedule a walkthrough with our solutions & ops teams, I'm available Tue/Wed next week.

Best,

Rafael Mendes
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai
+1 650-555-0199
Attachments: RFI_Attachment_Table_v3.xlsx (xlsx), network_diagram.pdf (pdf)

Rafael / Mina —

Quick security note after scanning the evidence table: security would prefer we replace the term "periodic key rotation" with explicit cadence. Suggested wording: "KMS keys rotated on a 90-day cadence; emergency rotation procedures documented in section 3.2 of the runbook."

Also recommend adding a short note about operator session recording for the pilot (we capture audit entries in the telemetry doc).

I can drop this into the XLSX and resend if you want.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Principal Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

Received your package, thanks. A couple of quick asks from procurement/legal after the initial review:

- We need a signed MOU for the pilot scopes (support windows, escalation points, data custody statement) before scheduling on-site work. Could you provide a DocuSign-ready MOU or confirm you can sign Clearwell's standard form?
- Confirm that the pilot timeline won't include remote egress unless explicitly approved by Clearwell's IT leadership.
- Please add the explicit key rotation language Ben suggested.

Forwarding your message to procurement/legal for completeness.
